item.title: Film About a Former Skinhead, Neo-Nazi Comes to Baltimore
item.description: On March 8, the Baltimore Jewish Council will host a screening of “The Cure for Hate” at Chizuk Amuno Congregation. This movie, filmed at Auschwitz, shares Tony McAleer’s inspiring journey from hate to reconciliation, encouraging hope for change and growth. item.title: Calvin Goldscheider, Baltimore Native and Jewish Scholar, Dies at 84
item.description: Calvin Goldscheider, a Baltimore native whose scholarship helped shape the study of Jewish demography and modern Jewish life, died of pancreatic cancer on Jan. 13 at his home in Bethesda, Maryland. He was 84. Born on May 28, 1941, Goldscheider grew up in a traditionally observant Jewish household with deep ties to Baltimore’s Orthodox community.
